setup_intro: A few questions, then you can add your first tank.
setup_instance_name_hint: Shown on the sign-in page, such as the room your tanks are in.
setup_timezone_hint: Dates and reminders use this timezone, not your browser's.
setup_units_intro: Choose how values are shown. If you switch units later, your saved readings, ranges and charts are shown in the new unit, and nothing is lost.
setup_login_on_hint: Recommended. Everyone signs in with a username and password.
setup_login_off_hint: Anyone who can reach this address has full access.
setup_login_locked: Set by REEFSHEPHERD_AUTH_MODE on the server.
setup_no_login_account: An administrator account named admin is created without a password. You can give it one later in Settings.
